svg.title: WealthSeva AI — Production Architecture (serverless) · ap-south-1 · 2026-07-12
svg.desc: Current-state production architecture for WealthSeva AI, a multilingual avatar wealth advisor (IDBI Innovate 2026). Serverless backend on AWS Lambda behind a public Function URL in ap-south-1. Two request paths: streaming chat goes directly from the browser to the Function URL; all other endpoints go through the Amplify SSR proxy which injects an x-origin-verify header. Bedrock Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Titan Embeddings v2 (keyword-fallback). EC2 is stopped as rollback. External SaaS (Supabase, Pinecone, Sarvam, ElevenLabs) sit outside the AWS Cloud boundary. CloudFront appears only as the Amplify-managed frontend CDN and never fronts the Function URL.
svg.text: Region ap-south-1 (Mumbai) · ADR-001 Option B · post-2026-07-11 serverless cutover · 2026-07-12

g.text: 5 languages: EN · HI · MR · TA · BN
